tldr_zh: OpenAI因安全隱憂暫停Astra模型，Meta遭紐墨西哥州法院判賠5.67億美元，Amazon德州數據中心電廠或成美國最大污染源。
tldr_en: OpenAI slows Astra development over cybersecurity threats; Meta ordered to pay $567M for youth mental health crisis; Amazon's Texas data center power plant risks becoming US's worst polluter.

items.title_zh: OpenAI因網路安全顧慮暫停Astra模型開發
items.title_en: OpenAI Slows Astra Model Development Over Cybersecurity Concerns
items.summary_zh: OpenAI表示其正在開發的Astra多模態模型已達到「關鍵網路安全閾值」，該模型可能獨立識別並對防護良好的真實系統發動網路攻擊。為此OpenAI決定放緩該模型的開發進度，以確保安全性。這反映了先進AI系統可能帶來的安全風險日益受到重視。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has slowed development of its Astra multimodal model after reaching a 'critical cybersecurity threshold.' The model could independently identify and conduct cyberattacks against well-protected real-world systems. The company is prioritizing security over rapid deployment, highlighting growing concerns about advanced AI safety risks.

items.title_zh: DeepMind颶風預測模型突破 提前預測能力增強
items.title_en: DeepMind's Hurricane Model Breakthrough Improves Weather Forecasting
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind開發的WeatherNext開源天氣模型能夠利用低解析度天氣數據進行準確預測，為氣象預報員爭取額外的預報時間。這項突破對於災害預警和公共安全具有重要意義，尤其是在極端氣候事件頻繁的時代。
items.summary_en: DeepMind's open-source WeatherNext model can make accurate hurricane predictions using lower-resolution weather data, buying forecasters extra time for warnings. This breakthrough has significant implications for disaster preparedness and public safety amid increasingly severe weather events.

items.title_zh: OpenAI收購簡報初創NextSlide 團隊加入ChatGPT開發
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布收購簡報軟體新創公司NextSlide，該公司的團隊成員現已加入ChatGPT開發團隊。這項收購表明OpenAI在擴展AI應用到商業生產力工具領域的戰略意圖。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has acquired presentation startup NextSlide, with the company's team now working on ChatGPT. This acquisition demonstrates OpenAI's strategy to expand AI capabilities into business productivity tools and workflows.

items.title_zh: Meta遭紐墨州法院判賠5.67億美元治療青少年心理健康危機
items.title_en: Meta Ordered to Pay $567M for Youth Mental Health Crisis
items.summary_zh: 紐墨西哥州法院認定Meta造成「公共危害」，判令其支付5.67億美元用於幫助青少年心理健康治療。法院認為Meta旗下社交媒體平台對青少年心理健康造成了實質傷害，這是對科技公司社會責任的重要司法判決。
items.summary_en: A New Mexico judge ruled Meta caused 'public nuisance' and ordered the company to fund $567M toward youth mental health treatment. The ruling recognizes social media platforms' damaging impact on adolescent mental health and holds tech companies accountable for societal harms.

items.title_zh: Amazon德州數據中心電廠或成美國最大污染源
items.title_en: Amazon's Texas Data Center Power Plant Could Be US's Worst Polluter
items.summary_zh: Amazon為其德州新建數據中心投資興建燃氣電廠，該電廠可能成為美國單一最大溫室氣體排放源。這引發了對科技巨頭數據中心能源消耗和環保責任的關注，特別是在AI應用驅動下數據中心需求迅速增長的背景下。
items.summary_en: Amazon's new gas-burning power plant in West Texas for its data center could become the largest source of greenhouse gas emissions from a single facility in the US. This raises concerns about tech giants' environmental responsibility as AI-driven data center demands surge.

items.title_zh: X推新內容獎勵計畫 取代現有創作者營收分享機制
items.title_en: X Replaces Revenue-Sharing Program with Original Content Rewards
items.summary_zh: X宣布終止其備受爭議的營收分享計畫，改以新的「原創內容獎勵」計畫取代，預定9月8日上線。新計畫要求創作者至少擁有500位驗證粉絲和50萬來自驗證用戶的首頁動態曝光，反映X在優化創作者激勵機制上的持續調整。
items.summary_en: X is ending its controversial revenue-sharing program for creators, replacing it with a new 'Original Content Rewards' program launching September 8th. Eligible creators must have at least 500 verified followers and 500,000 Home Timeline impressions from verified users.

items.title_zh: 火星探測車Perseverance自動駕駛成果顯著 近90%里程自主行駛
items.title_en: Mars Perseverance Rover's Autonomous Driving Proves Highly Successful
items.summary_zh: 美國NASA的火星探測車Perseverance約有90%的行駛距離是透過自動駕駛完成，驗證了太空探測自動化技術的成熟度。這項技術突破對未來更遠距離的太空探索任務具有重要意義。
items.summary_en: NASA's Perseverance rover has successfully driven autonomously for approximately 90% of its total distance traveled on Mars. This demonstrates the maturity and reliability of autonomous space exploration technology for future deep-space missions.

items.title_zh: 歐洲衛星服務新增野火監測 應對創紀錄森林火災季
items.title_en: Europe's Free Satellite Service Adds Wildfire Tracking Capability
items.summary_zh: 歐洲Copernicus衛星服務在其免費瀏覽器中新增野火可視化功能，協助監測和追蹤森林火災。此舉應對歐洲當前創紀錄的野火季節，展現衛星遙測技術在公共安全中的實際應用。
items.summary_en: Europe's Copernicus satellite service has added wildfire visualization capabilities to its free browser tool, helping track and monitor forest fires. The feature responds to record wildfire activity across Europe and demonstrates satellite technology's role in public safety.

items.title_zh: Git服務平台Gitea修補CVSS 9.8重大漏洞 無需登入可遠程執行程式碼
items.title_en: Gitea Patches Critical CVSS 9.8 Vulnerability Allowing Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
items.summary_zh: 開源Git服務平台Gitea修補編號CVE-2026-59774的重大漏洞，攻擊者無須登入即可透過文件處理功能讀取伺服器檔案並執行程式碼。該漏洞CVSS評分達9.8分，已在Gitea 1.27.1版本修補，影響企業軟體開發安全。
items.summary_en: Gitea has patched a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-59774) with CVSS score 9.8 that allowed unauthenticated remote code execution. Attackers could exploit file handling features to read server files and execute code without authentication. The patch is available in Gitea 1.27.1.

items.title_zh: 駭客入侵Oracle資料庫作跳板 在Windows執行惡意指令
items.title_en: Hackers Use Oracle Database Breaches as Springboard for Windows Attacks
items.summary_zh: 資安公司Huntress揭露駭客利用傳統SQL注入漏洞結合Oracle內建Java功能發動進階攻擊，將惡意工具包寫入資料庫，最終取得Windows系統SYSTEM權限。該案例顯示攻擊者利用多個系統漏洞串聯攻擊的複雜手法。
items.summary_en: Security firm Huntress discovered attackers exploiting SQL injection vulnerabilities combined with Oracle's built-in Java functionality to execute advanced attacks. Hackers deployed malicious tools inside databases to ultimately gain Windows SYSTEM privileges, demonstrating sophisticated multi-stage attack tactics.

items.title_zh: 丹麥高中生須口頭辯護書面作業 防止AI代筆濫用
items.title_en: Denmark Requires High School Students to Verbally Defend Written Assignments
items.summary_zh: 丹麥教育政策改革要求高中生必須口頭辯護其書面作業內容，旨在防止學生使用AI工具代筆作弊。此舉反映各國教育制度在AI時代面臨的挑戰，需要創新評估方式確保學習成效。
items.summary_en: Denmark has implemented a policy requiring high school students to verbally defend their written assignments to prevent AI-assisted plagiarism. This educational reform demonstrates how schools are adapting assessment methods to combat academic dishonesty in the AI era.

items.title_zh: 德國內政部長稱每日面臨來自國外混合戰威脅
items.title_en: Germany Faces Daily Hybrid Warfare Attacks from Foreign Sources
items.summary_zh: 德國內政部長多布林特表示，在萊比錫機場傳出無人機攜帶炸藥攻擊事件後，德國每天都面臨來自國外的混合戰攻擊。此警告反映歐洲地緣政治緊張局勢升溫，對國家安全構成新的威脅。
items.summary_en: Germany's interior minister warned that the country faces daily hybrid warfare attacks from foreign sources following a drone-bomb incident at Leipzig airport. The statement reflects escalating geopolitical tensions in Europe and emerging security threats to the nation.
